ana.decision.page.title: Decision log
ana.decision.page.subtitle: Each decision about a figure of the command center or an urgent alert is written with its reason and the figures as they were at that moment; nothing is edited, outcomes are added.
ana.decision.filters.subject: Subject of the decision
ana.decision.table.caption: Each row is a decision: day, subject, kind, figure at the time, follow-up and who decided
ana.decision.col.subject: Subject
ana.decision.recorded: The decision was recorded with the figures of this moment.
ana.decision.dialog.title: Record a decision
ana.decision.dialog.frozenBody: The system takes the figures you see now when you record and keeps them with a digest; they cannot be changed later.
ana.decision.dialog.subject: What the decision is about
ana.decision.dialog.followUp: Follow-up day (optional, at most {days} days ahead)
ana.decision.problem.denied: You may not record a decision about this subject.
ana.decision.problem.metricUnavailable: The figure could not be taken now, so no decision was recorded.
ana.decision.problem.alertGone: The alert is no longer among the work you may read.
ana.decision.problem.superseded: The decision was superseded, so no more outcomes are recorded.
ana.decision.problem.invalid: The content is not valid: check the kind, the reason and the follow-up day.
ana.decision.problem.failed: It could not be recorded; try again.
ana.decision.detail.title: Decision detail
ana.decision.detail.error: The decision could not be read.
ana.decision.digest.ok: The figures taken are intact: digest {digest}
ana.decision.digest.bad: The digest does not match: the figures taken were changed.
ana.decision.compare.noThen: The figure had no value at the decision.
ana.decision.compare.noNow: The figure has no value now.
ana.decision.compare.notReadable: The figure cannot be read now.
ana.decision.alert.frozen: The alert at the decision: {title}, level {severity}, status {status}.
ana.decision.alert.gone: The alert is no longer among your work.
ana.decision.tiles.summary: The figures of the command center at the decision ({count})
ana.decision.outcomes.title: Outcomes after the decision
ana.decision.outcome.label: Outcome
ana.decision.outcome.closed: The decision was superseded, so no more outcomes are recorded.
